SRC-103:R001.text: Audit manifest distinguishes durable audit surfaces from runtime/transient surfaces at any nesting depth, without excluding whole durable families

SRC-103:R002.text: Release SOURCE_COVERAGE is scoped to the release being shipped; an unrelated BLOCKED_EXTERNAL source cannot freeze an independent release while a related unresolved source still blocks

SRC-103:R003.text: Contract clause derivation is reachable before finish for every ingress, idempotent, crash-safe, and never overwrites an interpreted contract

SRC-103:R004.text: SOURCE_COVERAGE refusals carry code, receipt, linked work, release-scope membership, missing-derivation state and the canonical next action; never a false MISROUTED_PROJECT_BINDING escape

SRC-103:R005.text: authoritative_state=true means the artifact satisfies the declared protocol contract, not merely that mandatory STATE/BOARD/LOG files exist

SRC-103:R006.text: No SAIPENVIEW product workaround, no dishonest T-850 closure, no SRC-007 history rewrite, no hand-authored operator authority, no universally valid empty coverage
